title: VALCON: Benchmarking and Enhancing Value Consistency in Large Language Models via Dual-Role Variation

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically comparing an LLM's generative behavior with its context-cleared evaluative judgments under identical value principles to detect if surface-level compliance masks inconsistent value reasoning across roles.

Prompting LLMs with different national personas (China, United States, Portugal) across Chinese and English languages and projecting their responses to World Values Survey questions onto the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map to assess cultural relativity.
